title: Exchange Matching Engine
summary: C++20 price-time matching with durable acknowledgments, idempotent retries, snapshots, and deterministic recovery.
evidence: Independent reference and bounded mixed-session recovery campaign.
limitation: Synthetic local exchange; measured throughput is not production venue latency.
decisions: Make matching and conservation checks deterministic.
No multi-currency or fractional-price venue model.
Price levels, FIFO queues and indexed cancels
Expose price priority and arrival priority in explicit data structures.
One instrument; no live network or queue-position claim.
Journal before acknowledgment and original request IDs
Recover accepted commands and return the original response after a lost acknowledgment.
Retained history grows; filesystem durability assumptions still apply.
